verdict.rationale: Unleash's impact-metrics feature lets users define threshold-based rules that automatically trigger actions — progressing rollouts, pausing on latency/error-rate breaches, or disabling environments — which is genuine event-triggered automation ([unleash-docs-14],[unleash-docs-22],[unleash-docs-29]). However this is scoped narrowly to rollout safeguards rather than a general-purpose rule/event engine for arbitrary actions across the system. Missing for 10: evidence of a broader rule-definition system covering non-rollout events/actions, and independent confirmation the automation works reliably in practice.
